reports.title: Coursera Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Our guidance reflects the completion of the Udemy transaction on May 11, 2026 and incorporates Udemy's operating results from the date of acquisition. Guidance also reflects the expected pace of synergy realization during 2026, and therefore only a portion of the annual run-rate benefit is expected to be reflected in reported 2026 results.
